implementation.off_by_default: Every invocation is refused unless PANTHEON_EVOLUTION_LEGACY_CANCEL_ENABLED=true is set for that single command; no HTTP route, background worker, recurring timer, or compose variable is added.
implementation.plan: Reads Evolution owner store across all tenants via store.list_all(tenant_id=None), selects every decision with created_at <= cutoff (default 2026-11-10T03:43:51.369000+00:00) that is either currently proposed or already canceled with a review_chain step citing --task-id (default EVOLUTION-LEGACY-PROPOSALS-CANCEL-20261110), and outputs deterministic JSON with decision_id, tenant_id, target_type, target_id, action_type, decision_state, created_at, counts_by_tenant, counts_by_state, counts_by_tenant_and_state, outside_counts_by_tenant_and_state, selection_digest (sha256:...), and outside_digest (sha256:...).
implementation.apply: Requires --digest sha256:... matching the current plan selection_digest before mutating anything; for each selected decision still in proposed state, binds services.evolution.main._TENANT_CONTEXT to decision.tenant_id (resetting in finally) and invokes the existing cancel_proposal(decision_id, CancelRequest(actor_role='operator', actor_id=f'operator-maintenance:{task_id}', note=f'Cancelled legacy proposed decision per {task_id}', tenant_id=decision.tenant_id)) route handler; records every DecisionResponse receipt; and verifies post-apply that 0 legacy decisions remain proposed, selection_digest is unchanged, and outside_digest is byte-for-byte unchanged.
implementation.live_reload_visibility: cancel_proposal persists through EvolutionDecisionStore.put under the store's exclusive lock and atomic file replacement, updating _file_signature() so the live running pantheon-evolution-1 process automatically reloads the updated decisions.json on its next read.

tests_covered: test_default_off_refusal: unset and false PANTHEON_EVOLUTION_LEGACY_CANCEL_ENABLED rejected across build_plan, apply_plan, and CLI main(plan|apply) with exit code 2 and 0 mutations

test_multi_tenant_plan_and_apply_preserves_outside_decisions: under EVOLUTION_AUTH_MODE=token and EVOLUTION_AUTH_ALLOWED_TENANTS=tenant-dev (where external HTTP POST /api/evolution/proposals/{id}/cancel for pantheon-default returns 403), plan + apply cancels pre-cutoff pantheon-default and tenant-dev proposed rows through cancel_proposal while leaving post-cutoff proposed and pre-cutoff approved/executed/unrelated-canceled rows untouched (outside_digest identical)

test_idempotent_rerun_with_same_digest: re-running plan and apply with the same selection_digest after completion keeps selection_digest and outside_digest identical and performs 0 additional cancellations
test_digest_mismatch_fails_closed_before_mutation: mismatched --digest raises LegacyProposalCancelError / exit code 2 before mutating any row

test_live_store_reload_visibility: an already-loaded EvolutionDecisionStore instance automatically detects the atomic file replacement via _file_signature() and reloads the canceled state without restart
test_invalid_arguments_and_tenant_context_reset_on_error: invalid --before timestamp and empty --task-id fail closed, and _TENANT_CONTEXT resets in finally even if cancel_proposal raises

runtime_budget.cadence: one-shot operator maintenance CLI invocation only; 0 recurring jobs, 0 background loops, 0 event emitters
runtime_budget.persistent_writers: 0 new files, tables, queues, or caches; mutates existing decisions.json rows in place via EvolutionDecisionStore.put (~250 B cancel ReviewStep appended to review_chain per cancelled decision, ~51 KB one-time bounded delta for 205 pantheon-default rows on hosted dev)
runtime_budget.cap: bounded to pre-cutoff (<= 2026-11-10T03:43:51.369000+00:00) proposed decisions in existing owner store
runtime_budget.cleanup: not applicable (no temporary or new persistent storage created)
